notes_for_editor: Two data records only (a weather-station listing and an OpenStreetMap point). No built, staffing, fire or access history found. The Flat Top Complex wildfire review PDF read (firesmartalberta.ca) does not mention this lookout. A Reddit thread (r/alberta, search snippet only, not used) has an anecdote about a late-1960s fire at the tower; the page could not be read. Wikiloc and Reddit pages were blocked. The brief's built 2003 comes from the Alberta FRIAA WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT layer, marked Protected and not for public display, so it is not cited. Brief access 'closed' is not stated by any source read, so facts has no access key. The station point and the OpenStreetMap point have slightly different coordinates; the story does not say they are the same structure. The station's 1,034.9998 m elevation is a station value and is not used as tower height.
